title: Add product stock adjustment action and availability labels
goal: Extend the existing stock-enabled product catalog prototype with an item-level stock adjustment action and a user-visible derived availability label.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product catalog create, edit, list, name/SKU search, category filter, stock quantity, and availability filter behavior remains working.
User can open a compact Adjust Stock control from a product row/card without opening the full edit product form.
User can set a new stock quantity through the Adjust Stock control and see the changed stock quantity in the list.
Product list displays a derived availability label for each product: In Stock, Low Stock, or Out of Stock.
Availability filter behavior from SLICE-002 is preserved: in stock means stock_quantity greater than 0 and out of stock means stock_quantity equals 0.
The incremental run modifies the existing product catalog implementation instead of creating a separate stock or warehouse screen.
constraints: Use the previous stock-enabled products-app run as the baseline via --from-run, for example runs/run-006-products-add-stock.
Preserve existing /api/products route and root product catalog screen.
Prefer modifying existing product files over creating duplicate product catalog files.
Implement action.adjust-stock as screen-internal UI behavior unless the approved file plan explicitly allows a separate artifact.
No inventory reservations, stock history, supplier integration, order management, or warehouse workflow.
Continue using local JSON mock storage.
non_goals: Do not add inventory reservations or stock history.
Do not add a separate warehouse or stock management screen.
Do not change existing search/category/availability filter semantics except to keep them compatible with the new label display.
